svg.title: Bastion — arched blockhouse
svg.desc: A refined low blockhouse based on bastion concept 3. A wide arched gate, two short sloping buttresses and oversized battlements give it a compact, readable silhouette. It is deliberately lower and weaker-looking than the circular tower. Pure vector artwork, transparent background, shared lower anchor at y=458, light from upper left. No embedded images, textures, fonts or external resources. Stronger warm stone contours and more contrasting side planes clarify the existing edges without adding decorative detail.
